extDescription.message: Turn sideways images and videos upright from the right-click menu: rotate or flip them in place, or open them rotated in a new tab.

commandRotateLeft.message: Rotate the image under the pointer anti-clockwise

optionsSingleKeySub.message: Point at an image or video and press R (clockwise), L (anti-clockwise) or 0 (reset), with no other key
